newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL- CLIPPERS BEAT WARRIORS.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL- CLIPPERS BEAT WARRIORS.

text.p: Loy Vaught scored 22 points and rookie Lorenzen Wright added 17 as the Los Angeles Clippers stopped their four-game losing streak with a 112-106 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Monday.
Rodney Rogers had 16 points for the Clippers, who moved to one-half game behind Sacramento for seventh place in the Western Conference.

Charles Outlaw had a dunk to spark a 13-5 run and put the Clippers ahead for good, 80-78, with 11:41 left in the fourth quarter. Darrick Martin's layup capped the run and gave Los Angeles their biggest lead, 91-83, with 8:23 remaining.

Latrell Sprewell scored 28 of his 41 points in the first half as the Warriors built a 10-point lead. Chris Mullin added 17 points and Joe Smith had 16 for Golden State, which has lost eight of its last 11 games.
